pages.text: The $(item)Lament Well$() mourns what dies near it, and mourning is Sorrow.

pages.name: Lament Well
pages.text: 5 by 5 floor, a low ring round the hole, candles on the corners.

pages.title: Ghosts
pages.text: A creature that dies within 8 blocks of the well leaves a ghost for 30 seconds, and each ghost weeps Sorrow every second. 12 and 16 blocks at the higher tiers, and more ghosts at once.$(br2)From its second tier I could give it things of loss: a named thing, a broken tool, a music disc, a totem.
